items.name: Readability
items.evidence: This is a four-line change. It matches the surrounding style and has a short comment explaining why auth gets re-joined, which is nearly the same wording as the reference.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The change is minimal and stays inside prepend_scheme_if_needed. It uses the auth value that parse_url already returns. There are no new helpers, no duplicated logic and no debug leftovers.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The `if auth:` guard skips None and empty values. It adds no magic constants and no exception handling. The credentials are passed through exactly as parsed, so their encoding is not changed. All hidden tests pass (F2P 2/2, P2P 185/185).

items.name: prepend_scheme_if_needed public behaviour unchanged otherwise
items.name_zh: prepend_scheme_if_needed 其他公开行为不变
items.evidence: The signature is unchanged. The fix only adds `netloc = '@'.join([auth, netloc])` when auth is present, so URLs without credentials behave as before. There is no urllib3 patching or Python-version check, and the existing prepend tests pass.
